recovery_position: Resolve review_snapshot_commit from the canonical program, enumerate git rev-list <baseline_commit>..<review_snapshot_commit>, and revert every returned commit newest-to-oldest as one bounded operation.
limitations: The durable artifact defines the current-boundary-safe recovery algorithm; the canonical CI job supplies the authenticated exact-head execution receipt.
Recovery certification proves deterministic source restoration and baseline validation, not public release or real-world SEO outcomes.
